about: Each piece stands alone: fetch its `url` (and `require_urls`, kept at the same relative layout) and use it. Checks are Python 3 scripts that use only the standard library.

pieces.purpose: Few words on screen: the design carries the meaning. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
The `human-attention` method as an Agent Skills folder (SKILL.md and its references).
Report the copy an edit adds to a UI file.
pieces.input: One JSON object on stdin, as Claude Code sends to a hook. `tool_name` (Write, Edit, MultiEdit) and `tool_input` with `file_path` and `content` or `old_string`/`new_string`. Exit 0 allows. Exit 2 means the edit added too much copy; the write stands, with the message on stderr. Bad input or a kill switch always exits 0.

files.game.html:
Fever Dungeon

You are burning up. Your fever climbs every second and at one hundred you die.

Stand on a blue tile to cool down. Dodge the red embers. Reach the golden door in each of the rooms.

Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Pause with P or Escape. Good luck out there.

pieces.purpose: List the text a person will see in UI source and count the usual excess.
pieces.input: `copy-audit <file-or-dir>... [--json] [--max-words N] [--max-pairs N]`. Reads .html .vue .svelte .jsx .tsx and canvas text. Prints the copy and counts; with `--json`, one JSON object. Exit 1 only when a --max limit is given and exceeded.
